## Requirements (contract §In scope)

1. Measure first: hosted inventory of every predicate → claim count → registry row? Committed.
2. Register every measured camera predicate in the ontology source (volatility + half-life, strategy — spatial
   tolerance for coordinates, identity for external ids, categorical for operator/jurisdiction — directness per
   genre). `make gen`, commit, `make verify-gen`.
3. ADR (next free = ADR-104), `## Revisit trigger`, BL-057 home, Appendix F row + `BUILD.sh`, ADR index.
4. Hosted re-materialization in GCP (tagged image, `:latest` untouched), camera envelopes by outcome, re-run +0,
   scale section of `P28.1_resolution_eval.md` regenerated from a committed measurement file.
5. State what the numbers mean (value resolution within a subject) and do not mean (no cross-source dedup).

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1 committed hosted predicate inventory; every camera predicate carrying hosted claims has a registry row.
- AC2 LinkML/ontology-sourced change; `make gen` + `make verify-gen` clean; ADR + revisit trigger + home + App. F.
- AC3 resolution re-materialized in GCP; camera envelopes > 0; re-run +0; contradictions visible.
- AC4 eval report scale section regenerated from committed measurements; PROVISIONAL preserved.
- AC5 `make check` + `make test-db` + build-memory/backlog/spec validators green.

## Plan

1. Measure the hosted spine read-only (`sig` over `cloud-sql-proxy --token`): predicate × genre × claim count ×
   registry row → `docs/build/reports/p30.2a-hosted/predicate_inventory_before.json`.
2. Findings that reshaped the plan (all measured, 2026-09-24T05:4xZ): the camera claims' genres
   (`camera_registry`, `connector_run`) are NOT on the registry's genre axis; all 2,106,319 camera claims have
   `observed_at` NULL (the 1970 placeholder would make them HISTORICAL → U1); 0 camera groups span > 1 source.
   So registering rows alone would still resolve nothing truthfully — the genre axis and capture-time dating are
   in scope (ADR-104 §1, §4).
3. Ontology source `ontology/vocab/predicates.yaml` (additive: 2 genres, 14 predicates, optional
   `value_tolerance`) → `make gen`; resolver: `Ruleset.absolute_tolerance`, tolerance pooling + absolute U4,
   `Claim.observed_at_basis` + labelled rule; readers: `CAPTURE_TIME_JOIN` / `observation_time` in
   `reconcile.materialize` (+ the `reconcile resolve` CLI and three `api.store_pg` readers); materializer vocab
   memo + progress.
4. Commit, SHA-tagged image (`ops/gcp/materialize.sh --apply image|job|run resolution`), re-run +0, measure,
   regenerate `P28.1_resolution_eval.md` from `p30.2a-hosted/resolution_scale.json`.
5. ADR-104 + BL-057 + Appendix F + ADR index; D-P30.2-3 advanced; D-P30.2a-1 opened.

- Branch created from `83cd666`; baseline suites green (881 passed).
- Inventory measured + committed; ontology/resolver/readers changed; `make gen`; tests added; checkpoint commit
  `6e2fb01`; `make verify-gen` clean on the committed tree.
- Hosted pass 1 on image `materialize-6e2fb0161254`: execution `sig-materialize-w22ls` FAILED at its first write
  (06:06:50Z, the Cloud SQL connector reset the connection after the ~4.5 min read; 0 rows); retry

  ~06:20Z after 85,541 envelopes (kept — append-only, idempotent) and the write path was batched
  (commit `419342b`, one transaction per 1,000 rows).

  complete. +0 re-run `sig-materialize-8lzql` started 08:03:24Z on the SAME image.
- Independent fresh-context review (Phase 3 Pass 2): findings fixed — assert U2 vs absolute-U4 explicitly (new
  two-pool U4 test), UTC capture date, ADR wording (first-sighting limitation → D-P30.2a-2; lat/lon
  independence → P30.2b revisit trigger; batching in ADR §5), shaping docstring.
